think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., 0, -1) that change semantics (disable/enable an alternate mode) rather than acting as an ordered numeric tuning parameter. 3) Determine whether such a value causes qualitatively different behavior (feature off / different mechanism) versus merely being an extreme of the same behavior. 4) Classify as 'special knob' only if a documented sentinel exists; record that value.
